The historical PR626 CK target-forest minimum from PR816 remains **16,364 primitives per real component** when every parent weight may be **any signed power of two**, including different exponents on overlapping branches. Every nonunit edge costs at least **10 primitives per component** more than making its child a root. Deleting all `m` such edges gives the bound **16,364 + 10 m**. The existing unit-weight witness attains the floor. **Scoped negative result; no new kappa or additional circuit saving.**

This closes a class restriction left open by @dd-hemant's PR816. It uses ToikY's PR909 quarter-grid tail method with a new CK census and an edge-deletion proof for overlapping one-parent forests. The original 66,520-real-primitive saving belongs to PR816 and is retained, not rediscovered as a new improvement.

The complete finite core checks **174,048** ordered pair/sign/exponent cases, with exponents -3 through 3. Every nonunit case loses to a root; a written affine-cost argument closes both infinite tails. The finite arithmetic checks cover all 162 coefficient/direction families, including distant exponents. All **12,544** signed-unit multigraph cycle inequalities and an independent dense Prim solver recheck the attaining 16,364 minimum.

Reproduce offline with Python 3.12+ and its standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/ck-power-forest-bound/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/ck-power-forest-bound/test_package.py
```

The default verifier also runs the separate checker. Expected: `PASS_CK_POWER_FOREST_BOUND: 174048 finite cases; all integer exponents; forest floor 16364; original witness retained; no new kappa`. The infinite-domain statement combines the finite anchors with the written proof; it is not an infinite computational replay.

Full receipts match on CPython 3.14.4 and a minimal read-only input tree under isolated optimized CPython 3.12.3. The independent implementation uses dense quarter-grid rows, literal Horner instructions and Prim, without importing the primary proof/search code. It reproduces the complete census digest and executes **1,058 coefficient cases / 72,632 primitive instructions**, comparing every cost with the exact pinned native emitter function. Both implementations check all **716 arbitrary input columns in both panel orientations**. Nine primary controls, two coefficient controls and seven package tests pass; those tests include all 169 weighted forests on three targets and rejection of all 11 cyclic topologies. Historical full-source invoices are recomputed, all twelve source/provenance objects match their pinned Git blobs, and selected-record and staged whitespace checks pass.

**Concurrent overlap:** final refresh through PR961 found woklerx's X4 all-dyadic forest bound at **4257ddf4b755cd0ac3bd3b0f6281cc5b2b1f72ad**. Its forest-exchange reasoning is related and its coefficient domain is broader. This package adds independently checked evidence on the different **CK** matrix and a uniform nonunit-power penalty. It does not settle CK parent coefficients with other dyadic numerators. No PR961 implementation or numerical result is imported, and no priority is claimed for a general forest-exchange argument.

OS seed **36**, complex-supplier track. Exact base **007664306fff84fbb1c9a1b4053b69f439764034**; final fetch unchanged. Historical PR626 source **660de893d27bb7abd1d5b01b1640207528a5c851**, PR816 witness **133735a2cc2319c12ba5d786214b2217e083e7da**, and PR909 tail method **5896f6fce48ee1d507722cc91eb1dcccc878670d** are pinned and credited. No pinned sprint coordination issue existed; the claim is local. Only `research/ck-power-forest-bound/` is added.

The current PR890 conditional κ remains **0.001661957774647029**. The bound fixes the original compensation matrix, one-parent acyclic structure, separate coefficient clearing and original binary-Horner lowering. Multiple parents, helper-basis changes, other dyadic numerators, shared work, other lowerings and folded boundary operations remain outside scope. No changed supplier, fresh full native/frame/wrapper replay, hosted invoice, outer assembly, repository-wide suite, hosted CI pass or formal multiplication proof is claimed.

Credit @dd-hemant PR816, ToikY PR909, Oscar Fennell PR759, Sricharan Vagvala PR749, Ross Richardson PR917/932, concurrent woklerx PR961, and the retained Chafik Boukhalfa / Jeremy Kothe / icekylinx / DreamingOfClouds / eumemic source lineage. Prepared for **Gareth Davidson (@bitplane), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**; one AI agent, no independent human review. Apache-2.0; source notices preserved.
